snippet.title: Vampolitics - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A graveyard of forgotten spacefaring empires lies at your feet, Sovereign. The echoes of our once ancient civilization call to you. With your unmatched logistical skill, diplomacy, and martial prowess, the age of the Space Vampires shall rise once more under your grand banner.

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4089000?utm_source=yt

OFFICAL PAGE: https://vampolitics.com/

--------------------------------
I am so happy to finally announce the space-vampire management RPG game we have been working so hard on! 

more info to come!
